entries.differs: The config core reads the config files itself, so no fs.read reaches a port (omo-sdk/config/index.ts:21).
The address is resolved over the account listing (sessions.list, aliases.resolve), never through remote sessions.resolve (sdk-core/reads.ts:70).
move is not acted on, so the call answers not_implemented (omo-sdk/root/threads.ts:121).
The idempotency key goes to the alias registry only, so no store.idempotency_get is made and the rename runs again (sdk-core/controls.ts:102).
A thread with no live owner is refused not_resumable instead of renamed in its session file (control/rename.ts:31).
